grid: 100m pixel spacing, bbox rounded outwards to 100m; center sampling; rows north to south
IDW: k=8,p=2, same-position mean; ties by source row; if zero distance return same-position mean; all available points if <8
elk_sample: deterministic source-order stride ceil(N/3000); source row retained; sample only for bounded evaluation, not full-study conclusions
KDE: Gaussian 2D: sum(exp(-d²/(2h²)))/(2*pi*h²)*1e6; h=1000m; grid step=500m; bbox rounded outwards with 3h margin
DBSCAN: eps=500m,min_samples=10, self included, local UTM; border ambiguity compared by valid density-reachable membership
Moran: z=x-mean; I=n/S0 * sum_i,j(wij*zi*zj)/sum_i(zi²); queen weights row standardized; islands zero; local Ii=(zi/m2)*sum_j(wij*zj), m2=sum(zi²)/n
permutation: numpy Generator(PCG64(42)), 999 permutations; two-sided p=(1+count(abs(I_perm-EI)>=abs(I_obs-EI)))/1000, EI=-1/(n-1); zero variance -> undefined
point_polygon_tie: smallest stable polygon ID, or source row if no unique ID
